summary_en: MFS announced a share buyback program with a maximum purchase price of ¥100 million and up to 400,000 shares (3.88% of outstanding shares) from November 13 to December 30, 2026, via market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The shares will be used for equity compensation to executives and employees.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On November 12, 2026, MFS Inc. announced a treasury stock acquisition program approved by its Board of Directors. The company will acquire up to 400,000 shares representing 3.88% of outstanding shares, with a maximum spending limit of ¥100 million. The acquisition will be conducted through open market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 13 through December 30, 2026.

The primary purpose of this buyback is to obtain treasury shares for use as equity compensation for the company's executives and employees. This shares-based remuneration aligns employee incentives with shareholder value creation and supports long-term retention of key talent. The company noted that market conditions may result in partial or full non-execution of the acquisition plan, and the method and timing of any future disposition of acquired shares have not yet been determined.
